facts.claim: The east crosscut from the Ralston winze was advanced 12 feet this week, revealing several small streaks of rich ore.
facts.quote: The east crossent from the Ralston winze has been advanced 12 feet this week, with several small streaks of rich ore in face of the crossent.

facts.claim: The winze reached a depth of 94 feet, below the 620 level, and was sunk and timbered an additional 14 feet last week.
facts.quote: This winze has attained a depth of 94 feet, below the 620 level, and has been sunk and timbered the past week 14 feet.
